start: Workout open, a timed exercise (Plank) with a goal of 0:45 from last time, set 1 not done

steps.action: Tap the timer button on set 1 ('Start the timer for ...')
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Plank · Set 1'
Line 'Countdown from 0:45. The set saves itself at zero.'
Buttons '−5 s', 'Stopwatch', '+5 s' and 'Start'
must_not: The sheet opening with a clock already running

steps.action: Tap Start
user_sees: The clock counts down; the main button reads 'Pause'; 'Stop and save' shows the time so far
must_not: The goal buttons still shown while it runs

steps.action: Wait until zero
user_sees: Bell and buzz; the sheet closes; set 1 shows 0:45 and is ticked; the rest timer starts
must_not: The set saved twice
The set saved with a time other than the goal

start: Workout open, a timed exercise with no goal time on the set

steps.action: Tap the timer button on the set
user_sees: Line 'Stopwatch. Stop when you finish the set.'
Main button 'Start'
must_not: A countdown from zero that ends at once

steps.action: Tap Start, hold, then tap 'Stop and save 0:52'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the set shows 0:52 and is ticked
must_not: The time rounded up to a goal
The set left unticked

steps.action: On a set with a goal, tap 'Stopwatch' before Start
user_sees: The line changes to the stopwatch line and the goal buttons go away
must_not: The old goal still used at save

start: Timer sheet open in countdown, not started

steps.action: Tap '−5 s' many times
user_sees: The goal stops at 0:05
must_not: A goal of 0:00 or a minus time

steps.action: Start and at once look at 'Stop and save'
user_sees: 'Stop and save' is greyed and cannot be tapped before one second
must_not: A set saved with 0 seconds

steps.action: On a set that is already ticked, tap its timer button
user_sees: Nothing opens; the button is disabled
must_not: A second time written over the done set

start: Countdown running on a plank, phone on the floor

steps.action: Brush the dimmed area outside the panel
user_sees: Nothing happens; the clock keeps running
must_not: The sheet closing and the time lost

steps.action: Press Back
user_sees: 'Stop the timer?' with 'Keep 0:42', 'Discard' and 'Keep going'; the clock still runs
must_not: The clock stopping while it asks

steps.action: Tap Discard, then open the timer on the same set again
user_sees: The sheet closes with nothing saved; reopened it shows a fresh clock and 'Start'
must_not: The old time written to the set
The old clock still counting

steps.action: Start, tap Pause, then Resume
user_sees: Pause stops the clock; the main button reads 'Resume'; Resume carries on from the same time
must_not: The clock jumping by the paused time
